- `gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/stream/JsonReader.java:416` — `hasNext()` now returns false at `PEEKED_EOF` (END_DOCUMENT).
- `gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/internal/bind/JsonTreeReader.java:104` — `hasNext()` now also returns false for `END_DOCUMENT`.

Full `gson` module test suite passes: 1084 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors.
